profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Tatari TV | ex-Amazon
profile.summary:
Why did I study both Computer Science and Electrical Engineering? I wanted to understand how a computer works from start to end — from how transistors in a computer chip open and close circuits to send 0’s and 1’s to how a high-level API is integrated into an app.
I am bilingual in Spanish and English, a natural leader, and a very curious learner.

projects.title: Smart Home - REST API, Python, Flask, PHP, SQLite
projects.description:
Building and programming a home automation system that can use machine learning to maximize energy efficiency in the home. 
I am the lead developer of a user-controlled web app that uses REST API and AWS to dynamically run. The app logs the individual user's patterns in a database while protecting user privacy to further optimize the performance of the system.
Designing the IoT devices such as smart plugs, smart switches, and smart locks that communicate with the main hub through MQTT protocol.

projects.title: decliningXchange - Full Stack Development
projects.description: Project to offer a solution for campus students. Through a back-end database and a front-end UI, this program will allow students to buy/trade items and services payed with campus money.
